notes: The %existchk macro (a data-set/variable-existence validation helper used internally by the file's main %PRcurve macro) is byte-identical to the repo's macro. The repo ships this macro with no caller; the calls at the bottom exercise all three of its documented outcomes (data+vars found; a requested variable missing; the data set itself missing) against a small synthetic dataset (8 rows, mock predicted score + binary outcome, not real patient data).
